column1: # binaries.tsv — REVIEWED binary files of the public mirror (your-org/nexus-code#1812).
# The scrub is a text substitution and never touches a binary: build.sh copies
# every binary (git: i/-text) VERBATIM, and verify-build.py fails the build if
# one was rewritten, or if a binary in the tree is not listed here with the
# blob sha it has today. A row is a human statement that the file at that
# exact blob carries no internal identifier (pixels and metadata included).
# A new or changed binary therefore stops the build until someone reviews it:
# ship it (add or update the row), drop it (an `exclude` row in the private
# mapping), or replace it in source.
